annotations.title: Is demand for this real, or is search moving for everyone?

description: Use when the user asks whether interest in a product, category or trend is really growing, or wants to know if a rise in search is more than noise before investing in it. Returns the category's year-on-year search change against an everyday basket of ten unrelated searches (its growth beyond the market), a volume band, and whether SEC 10-K filings confirm the direction, the costly-to-fake check. Changes and bands only, never monthly volumes. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.07 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For whether interest is lasting or past its peak, use run_fad_check; for brands' shares of search, use run_share_of_search. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/demand-check.json
